source: Baseline notebook for the inverse square roots benchmark.

# 01 · Reproducible setup
import numpy as np
from kickmix import Circuit, verifier

# 02 · Benchmark configuration
BENCHMARK = "invsqrt"
SEED = 20261021

# 03 · Candidate circuit
def build_candidate(x_bits: int = 14) -> Circuit:
    circuit = Circuit()
    circuit.prepare_basis_state(x_bits)
    circuit.apply_polynomial_phasing(
        coefficients=[0.9999413, -0.4960989, 0.3326111, -0.1487676],
        domain=(1.0, 2.0),
    )
    circuit.uncompute_workspace()
    return circuit

# 04 · Verify before submission
candidate = build_candidate()
report = verifier.check(candidate, seed=SEED)
print(report.score, report.passed)\n
